evidence: Modifies core cryptographic primitives in src/crypto/ (chacha20 implementation and vector optimizations).
rationale: Optimizes a core cryptographic primitive used by BIP324 v2 transport, yielding a measured 2-3x speedup. The author notes that 'chacha20 accounts for a substantial amount of the network thread's time' and benchmarks demonstrate 'a 2x speedup on x86-64 and 3x for arm+neon'.
